purpose: Bind every count-shaped conclusion in this repo to a recorded commit and a recorded suite total, so a count cannot drift silently.
suite_total_note: Collected at measured_at_commit, before the baseline module itself existed. A count-shaped conclusion is not recomputed and reused across a changed suite.

injection.note: A projection that writes the authoritative column back, in the dict-literal-key form that the first enumeration version missed. Counted as a second write site. Applied to a scratch copy of the scanned tree, never to the real tree.
injection.injection_note: The injected writer lives only in a scratch copy, so it never enlarges the real write-site set and never makes the real-tree assertion red on its own.

expected_red_count_note: The count is re-derived at run time by tests/test_suite_baseline.py, which executes every test in the write-site module against an injected scratch tree and counts how many fail. This file records the number; the test proves the number is still true.

superseded_claim.why_superseded: Re-measured on the tree at c88efad: the injection turns exactly two assertions red, not three. The third assertion named in the earlier claim operates on a scratch copy of the tree, so it does not observe an injected writer in the real tree and stays green. The earlier number was not re-derived before it was published.
superseded_claim.correction_status: corrected in README, in the commit message of the correction commit, and reported to the peer who asked for the coupling measurement.
